title: test(ui-merge): the repo-gates wiring pins retire with their port; "no workflow runs this" pins read the root workflows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAqVfFyhsxKuFcEP9YTBj25)_

Part of #25712 (4b PR 2d-2a: the per-gate wiring pins among the `ui/scripts/__tests__` files that scan `ui/.github/workflows/` stop reading it).
Part of objectstack#25677.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** `ui/scripts/__tests__` 里有 18 个测试文件扫描嵌套的 `ui/.github/workflows/` 目录,问的是“哪个 workflow 运行这个 gate”。这个目录在 monorepo 里根本不运行。其中 14 个文件的 gate 唯一的家是 objectui 的 `repo-gates.yml`,根目录没有任何 workflow 运行它们。它们的接线 pin(home、trigger、path filter、install 顺序、step 名、header 计数)退役,注释写明由 #25880 承接(#25880 把这 19 个 gate 移植进根 `Lint UI`,届时把 pin 指回那个 job)。不读 workflow 的用例全部保留。另外 4 个文件断言“没有 workflow 运行这个 gate”,改为扫描根目录 `.github/workflows/`(新的 `rootWorkflowFiles()`)。
- **为什么改:** 2d-3 要删除 `ui/.github/workflows/`。删之前这 18 个文件必须先不依赖它。改完以后,不管 `ui/.github/workflows/` 在不在,这 18 个文件都是绿的(本地两种布局都是 1,034 个用例通过)。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 只动测试、一个测试 helper 和一个测试 ledger,不动任何会运行的代码、workflow 或受管面。退役的 pin 有 #25880 接回。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **席位意见:**(留空)
- **你要做的:** 无。Tier S,由席位落地。

## 席位核对

(left for the dispatch seat)

## Why

GitHub runs only the repository root's `.github/workflows/`. Since the cutover (#25825), objectui's workflows sit at `ui/.github/workflows/` and run nowhere. 2d-1 (#25879) moved the 28 files that read `ui/.github/workflows/ci.yml` to the root `ci.yml`. This PR takes 18 of the 27 files that scan the workflow directory as a population. The dispatcher split the population in two: the other 8 (the governance files, which read through `workflow-checks.ts` or scan every workflow for a repo-wide rule) are 2d-2b. `check-pre-install-import-graph` stays with 2d-3, because its gate, not just its test, derives its population from the nested workflows.

The rule is the 2d-1 rule: retarget a pin to the root workflows by path, or retire it with a comment naming who carries its subject. Nothing is skipped and nothing is folded into a root workflow.

The 19 gates in `ui/.github/workflows/repo-gates.yml` run in no root workflow. #25880 ports them into the root `Lint UI` job. Per the dispatcher, the pins on their wiring retire against #25880, not against roster row 24.

## What changes

- **14 files: gate-wiring pins for `repo-gates.yml` gates retire against #25880.** Each file loses its `ui/.github/workflows` reads and the cases built on them: `has a workflow that gates pull requests`, `runs it in NO path-filtered workflow`, `has exactly one home`, the install-order half of `needs no install`, `subscribes merge_group`, step-name assertions, `does not run a NEIGHBOUR gate`, and the header-count pins. The note where they were names #25880. Every case that reads no workflow stays:
  - the `package.json` aliases;
  - the import-graph walks of `needs no install` (`check-doc-component-types`, `check-prompt-component-keys`), kept as `needs no install: its import graph reaches no package`;
  - `check-doc-snippet-types`'s build-filter emission cases;
  - the `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` and `dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` classification halves;
  - the CI-page section and by-command row pins;
  - `check-doc-component-types`'s three header-count controls, which exercise `documentCounts` and `headerComments` on synthetic text. They become the controls of the pin #25880 brings back.
- **`check-doc-snippet-types`' `the build-filter steps propagate failure…` describe (6 cases) retires.** It ran the `run:` scripts of two `repo-gates.yml` steps under bash. #25880 carries those steps, and the cases come back against them.
- **4 files: "no workflow runs this" pins ask the root directory.** `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-i18n-dead-keys`, `check-lint-rule-coverage` and `check-published-dist-tooling` (the per-PR half) each asserted that no workflow runs a gate. They now read the root `.github/workflows/` through `helpers/root-ci.ts`:
  - `rootWorkflowsDir`;
  - `rootWorkflowFiles()`, which refuses a scan that reads fewer than 10 files, so a "nothing names this" pin cannot go vacuous;
  - `rootWorkflow(file)`.

  `check-published-dist-tooling`'s `runs nightly` read `published-dist-gate.yml` and retires as roster **row 23** (kept, follow-up port).
- **`ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`.** Its scanner flagged every removed `readdirSync(workflowDir)` as a directory walk, so the ledger changes:
  - ten entries drop that `walker:` declaration;
  - three entries the scanner no longer offers at all are removed: `check-i18n-dead-keys` and `check-lint-rule-coverage` (both `reads: []`), and `check-prompt-component-keys`.

  The prompt-keys test still reads `.github/prompts/*.prompt.md`, but through the gate's exported `PROMPT_DIR`, which the scanner cannot see. 2d-3 moves those prompts to the root `.github/prompts/` (dispatcher ruling), outside the tree this ledger describes. Test UI runs the whole suite on every ui change, so no selection depends on the entry today.

### Disposition table (18 files)

| # | File | Retired (reads `repo-gates.yml` unless noted) | Kept | Carried by now |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `check-doc-component-types` | workflow, path filter, one home, install order, header-count pin | alias, import-graph walk, 3 header-count controls | #25880 |
| 2 | `check-doc-example-ids` | workflow, path filter, one home, install order, header count | alias, neighbour-alias pin | #25880 |
| 3 | `check-doc-example-types` | workflow, path filter, one home, after build, after sibling; the alias case's workflow half | CI-page by-command row, alias | #25880 |
| 4 | `check-doc-json-fences` | one home + filter, after build and siblings | alias + CI page | #25880 |
| 5 | `check-doc-snippet-types` | workflow, path filter, one home, builds a filter, builds before; the objectui#6221 step-script describe (6) | build-filter emission (3), alias | #25880 |
| 6 | `check-prompt-component-keys` | one home, unfiltered, install order | alias, import-graph walk | #25880 |
| 7 | `check-readme-exports` | one home, no trigger filter, triggers, builds before; step names | alias, `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` classification | #25880 |
| 8 | `check-shell-escape-residue` | workflow, merge_group, path filter, one home, install order | alias, `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` classification | #25880 |
| 9 | `check-skill-eval-tokens` | workflow, self-test, installs nothing, path filter, one home, neighbour; step name | alias, classification, CI-page heading | #25880 |
| 10 | `check-skill-examples` | workflow, self-test, derived build filter, path filter, one home, neighbour; step name | alias, classification, CI-page heading | #25880 |
| 11 | `check-skills-paths` | workflow, path filter, one home | alias, baseline | #25880 |
| 12 | `check-vi-mock-inherit` | workflow, merge_group, path filter, one home, install order | alias | #25880 |
| 13 | `check-vi-mock-specifiers` | workflow, merge_group, path filter, one home, install order | alias | #25880 |
| 14 | `docs-links-workflow` | runs the checker, triggers, no path filter, one home, docs-only startable; the workflow half of `exists at all` | script exists, alias | #25880 |
| 15 | `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask` | (none) | `nothing GitHub runs names this gate` | retargeted: root `.github/workflows/` |
| 16 | `check-i18n-dead-keys` | (none) | `is NOT invoked by any GitHub workflow` | retargeted: root `.github/workflows/` |
| 17 | `check-lint-rule-coverage` | (none) | the inverse pin, `not in a workflow yet` | retargeted: root `.github/workflows/` |
| 18 | `check-published-dist-tooling` | `runs nightly` (`published-dist-gate.yml`) | `is NOT wired into any per-PR workflow` | per-PR half retargeted: root `.github/workflows/`; nightly half roster **row 23** |

Some pins outlive their meaning but still read no workflow. For example, the CI page still says the doc gates block. They stay green and are #25880's to restate when the gates run again.

### What 2d-2b and 2d-3 still owe (not here)

- **2d-2b (8 files):** `dependabot-merge-gate`, `merge-queue-reporting`, `check-lockfile-dedupe`, `check-lockfile-integrity` (all through `workflow-checks.ts`), `ci-setup-pnpm-wiring`, `workflow-cache-save-bound`, `doc-version-claims`, and `labeler-package-coverage`. The last of these is retargeted to the root `.github/labeler.yml`, which gains the `ui/` globs it lacks (dispatcher ruling on F12).
- **2d-3:** `check-pre-install-import-graph`, `check-action-ref-convention` (its gate scans the nested workflow directory), and the 24 single-workflow readers. It also moves the three `ui/.github/prompts/*.prompt.md` files to root `.github/prompts/`, with a separate prompts root for `check:prompt-keys`, and deletes `ui/.github/dependabot.yml` and the workflows once #25880 lands.

## Verification

Run from `ui/` per `ui/AGENTS.md`, at this head (`main` `6e0597f2` plus this commit):

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| The 18 modified test files, `ui/.github/workflows/` present | 18 files, 1,034 tests, all passed |
| The same 18 files with `ui/.github/workflows/` moved aside (the 2d-3 layout) | 18 files, 1,034 tests, all passed |
| The same 18 with all of `ui/.github/` moved aside | 17 pass; `check-prompt-component-keys` fails 7 prompt-surface cases, because the prompts are under `ui/.github/prompts/`. 2d-3 moves them (above). |
| Whole `scripts/__tests__` suite, `--shard=1/4` through `4/4`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` | 5,403 passed, 1 failed, 2 skipped, after the ledger fix |
| Every test that imports `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` (10 files) | 340 passed |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | the one error is `packages/components/src/renderers/action/resolve-icon.ts(265,69)` TS2339, identical on unmodified `main` here; none in a touched file |
| `pnpm exec eslint --max-warnings=0` (touched files), `lint:coverage`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`; root `pnpm check:test-source-alias` | all exit 0 |

The one suite failure is the base red riding `main` since 2c: `check-pre-install-import-graph`, `unresolved: scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs`. It clears in 2d-3 with the nested workflows.

Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` from this diff): 18 families, all exit 0 at this head. `--ran` reconciles 18 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The slowest were `check:query-options-erasure` (320 s), `check-comment-mask-corpus` (202 s) and `check:engine-double-contract` (68 s).

The push-environment battery (`GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`, both tiers) is running on this head. Its line goes to the dispatch seat.
